name: FineVoice
summary: AI audio suite for creators: text to speech, voice changer, voice cloning, speech to text, sound effects, background music and talking photos under one credit-based subscription, with a free daily allowance.
best_for: solo creators, educators and small teams who want text to speech, voice changing, cloning, transcription and sound effects in one subscription, and who use most of the quota every month
skip_if: you need long-form narration beyond the monthly character quota, or you want to publish commercially without paying
honest_knock: Monthly and annual Ultra are different products, and the pricing page only half says so: the annual card says Unlimited for every tool, while the comparison table (which FineVoice says covers the monthly plans) caps monthly Ultra at 600,000 text-to-speech characters a month. Even annual Ultra keeps one cap, 720 AI Talking Photo Pro credits a month. Unused characters and minutes expire at the end of each month, the money-back window is 15 days, and free output is for personal, non-commercial evaluation only.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-23 on finevoice.ai/pricing, USD selected) FineVoice has a free plan and three paid tiers. Billed monthly: Basic $8.99, Pro $17.99 (the table offers 28% off the first month, $12.99) and Ultra $24.99. Billed annually: Basic $71.99, Pro $99.99 and Ultra $129.99 a year, which the cards show as $5.99, $8.33 and $10.83 a month. The plans are quotas across a suite of audio tools. In the comparison table, text to speech gets 1,000 characters a day on Free, then 100,000, 300,000 and 600,000 characters a month on Basic, Pro and Ultra, with at most 5,000 characters per input on the paid plans; the voice changer gets 3 minutes a day on Free, 24 hours on Basic and unlimited on Pro and Ultra; speech to text gets 30 minutes a day on Free, then 120, 240 and 420 minutes. Instant voice clones run 3, 50, 100 and 300. Unused characters and minutes do not carry over to the next month, and sales tax may be added depending on where you live. The annual Ultra card lists every tool as Unlimited, while the comparison table on the same page gives Ultra 600,000 text-to-speech characters a month and 420 minutes of speech to text. FineVoice told us on 23 October 2026 that the table describes the monthly plans: on annual Ultra most tools are unlimited, except AI Talking Photo Pro, which is capped at 720 credits a month (AI Talking Photo Flash stays unlimited).

compare_with.name: Murf
compare_with.why: Murf is in our dossiers as a voiceover studio: on 3 October 2026 its Creator plan was $19 a month billed annually. FineVoice costs less per year and spreads its quota across many audio tools (voice changer, cloning, transcription, sound effects and music), while Murf is the narrower choice if the job is voiceover production
